rounds.sentence: I packed a hat ___ a coat.
The box is small ___ very heavy.
I wore my boots ___ it was raining.
She was happy ___ she won the game.
It got dark ___ we went inside.
He felt tired ___ he took a rest.

page_intro.en: Hazel the heron builds a little word-bridge between two ideas, and a joining word holds it together. Read each sentence, then tap the word that fills the blank — and, but, because, or so — so the two parts make sense. A warm Grade 1 grammar game about using conjunctions to join ideas, aligned to Common Core L.1.1.g.
